findings.reader: A disciplined, well-scoped news article: it reports the dated declaration and interview accurately, keeps explicit evidence limits beside every claim, defines its one technical term in context, and converts the answer-versus-understanding distinction into a concrete, proportionate self-check. Explain-back and a novel transfer scenario both succeed using only the article's mechanism. No defect families present.
findings.facts: Both material claims are supported: the 25-signatory September 11 declaration and its benchmark argument match the Le Monde text, and Figalli's acceleration-versus-judgment assessment matches the ETH interview. Attribution and evidentiary limits are preserved in the article itself, dates make claims reviewable, and uncertainty is not flattened.
